ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio characterized by approximately 65-70% high-intensity white pixels located on the lateral lobes and 30-35% low-intensity black pixels concentrated in a central contiguous region.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large, centrally-located irregular black region with dendritic, feathered margins. Lateral lobes are predominantly white with secondary sparse black mottling and several isolated dark circular focal spots in the distal quadrants.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped central notch with an estimated internal angle of 45-55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular trailing edge topography with high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations. Notable larger indentations are visible on the inner-left trailing margin.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curvature along the trailing margins, sweeping into sharp upward-angled distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular, high-contrast white/grey ring marks (cicatrices) concentrated in the central black region and mid-right white lobe. Dense clusters of high-intensity, textured pixel groups (barnacles) on both extreme lateral tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Visible vertical parallel linear markings on the lower-left fluke region and scattered diagonal linear disruptions on the lower-right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant accumulation of barnacle colonies forming dense, irregular crusts on the distal margins of both fluke tips; presence of numerous circular ectoparasite scars.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinct, isolated dark circular mark with high edge contrast located in the lower-central region of the right lobe.
